races.display_title: Paul Ferguson's Jumpers To Follow Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: LORIKO continues to carry all before him this summer, making it 4 wins from his last 5 starts at Sedgefield last week and Dan Skelton's 5-y-o gets the verdict to carry on his winning spree under a 6-lb penalty. Bold Light is a long time without a win, but he's become potentially well handicapped as a result so can provide most resistance, with Continuance rounding off the shortlist returned to calmer waters. LORIKO (FR) BOLD LIGHT (IRE) CONTINUANCE
races.betting_forecast: Loriko (4/5), Bold Light (6/1), Continuance (7/1), Dream's Ka (7/1), Starlyte (8/1), Heart Above (14/1)

races.verdict: RESPONSE FINALE was unlucky not to go closer at Laytown last week and can notch a third win for the Cromwell yard. races.display_title: Jerry McDonnell Memorial Tipperary Perpetual Cup Handicap
races.verdict: NOT JUST ANY EAGLE hasn't won since spring 2025, but Patrick Flynn's 7-y-o has signalled his turn is imminent in recent weeks and now reunited with his usual pilot, gets the nod to notch career victory number 6. Lady Plimsoll made it 5 placings on the spin when runner-up at Killarney last month so she heads up the opposition, with Zoffman and Zanahiyr taken to fight out third. NOT JUST ANY EAGLE (IRE) LADY PLIMSOLL (IRE) ZOFFMAN (IRE)

races.display_title: John Thomas McNamara Series (Q.R.) Handicap
races.verdict: GALLO DELL CIELO was most impressive at Tramore last month and is taken to defy a hefty rise, still leaving him below his last winning all-weather mark, and make it 4 wins from his last 5 starts. Rich Belief isn’t the force of old but won over hurdles a few months ago and should be suited by the return to a marathon trip on the Flat, while handicap debutant Highlander Addict is respected having previously won a bumper. GALLO DELL CIELO (IRE) RICH BELIEF HIGHLANDER ADDICT (IRE)
races.betting_forecast: Gallo Dell Cielo (6/5), Miss Gitana (4/1), Rich Belief (6/1), Piatra Neamt (10/1), Peace Walk (12/1), Cornmarket (12/1), Duke Otto (12/1), Highlander Addict (20/1)

races.verdict: MAO SHANG WONG is now operating only 1 lb above the mark he defied over C&D in the spring and encouragingly recaptured his peak form when finishing a good second at Newcastle 2 weeks ago. He has the services of a good value claimer back on board and shades preference over Bearwith and Great Blasket . 3-y-o Ohara is another worthy of a second look. races.display_title: EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: FLORAL MAID produced a promising debut effort when staying on strongly for second in a C&D maiden 17 days ago, likely to have won in another few strides and pulling well clear of the remainder. races.display_title: We Are Christmas Party Central Handicap
races.verdict: BRUMMELL turned in his best effort of the season when third in a race that is working out well at Doncaster last month and, successful on each of his 2 previous visits here, he could well be ready to strike reunited with his good value claimer. Almarada Prince has been holding his form very well and he's an obvious threat from a handy draw. BRUMMELL (IRE) ALMARADA PRINCE (IRE) DESERT TREASURE

races.display_title: EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: ROKU NANA produced a promising first effort at Goodwood 18 days ago and this well-bred filly can build on that to open her account. Edward Bethell introduces 2 newcomers that make appeal on pedigrees so a market check regarding Benedetti and Engedi is advised as one of them could be the selection's biggest danger. ROKU NANA BENEDETTI ENGEDI (IRE)

races.display_title: Hurn Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict: CASILLI has an outstanding Beverley record with 5 wins (3 over C&D) and, whilst on a 21-run losing sequence, her sixth at Ripon last month was likely needed after 12 months off and she's never encountered a race as weak as this before. She therefore could be the one to side with despite a poor draw. Copper And Five should be a threat back at this venue, while Itszaboy has the most to recommend him of the younger rivals. CASILLI COPPER AND FIVE ITSZABOY
